{"id":"mimid-1wgh.114.4","title":"The JMAP spec edits the call work implies, and the server change that goes with them","description":"Swept 2026-11-23 by reading the JMAP drafts against what bead
mimid-1wgh.108 built, under Mark's constraint: do not overspec against
what we built, but make it cohere and interoperate.

EVERY WRITE TO ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec NEEDS MARK'S OWN OK, one per
write (AGENTS.md). Nothing here is written yet.

1. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Calls, LAST PARAGRAPH IS STALE. It
   says "A later revision may say what a call bound to a MIMI room
   derives its media keys from." That revision exists:
   draft-atwood-mimi-calls. Replace the sentence with a pointer to it.
   One sentence, no new normative text.

2. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Room/create, THE REFUSALS ARE NOT
   STATED. Check 7 requires only that base_room_policy "parses", so a
   parent-dependent room is already legal and nothing needs permitting.
   But the hub now refuses two cases a client cannot predict from the
   draft: a parent_room this server does not host, and a participant list
   outside the parent's. Add both to the invalidArguments conditions.
   At creation check 4 already forces exactly one participant, so the
   second reduces to "the creator is a participant of the parent" --
   state it that way, which is less text and more precise.

3. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Room/create, NO CHAT FOR A
   PARENT-DEPENDENT ROOM: decision mimid-1wgh.120, including what chatId
   is in the response when there is no Chat.

4. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00: ONLY the bridge of decision mimid-1wgh.118
   -- how a VTCCall relates to a MIMI call room and how a client gets
   media_secret. Do NOT touch e2eeEnabled: "the mechanism ... is
   media-layer-defined; this field is the state signal for client UI" is
   exactly the seam that let our keying slot underneath, and changing it
   would break the thing that made this possible. That work is bead
   mimid-1wgh.114.2.

5. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00: NOTHING. Considered and rejected a fourth
   Chat.kind (decision mimid-1wgh.120). The base draft does not change.

THE SERVER CHANGE THAT GOES WITH 3: mimid-server
jmap/methods/room_create.rs binds the Chat and then reads it back out of
projection_chats to answer chatId, so suppressing the Chat for a
parent-dependent room is a response-shape change as well as a skipped
write. The agent's own JMAP front end projects rooms as Chats too and
needs the same rule; Room::parent already marks which rooms.

WHAT WAS CHECKED AND NEEDS NOTHING: §Calls' mapping of a session part to
a vtc MessageAction is consistent with decision mimid-1wgh.114.3 (§5.10
is for external conference URLs). Its rule that "A session part whose url
carries any other scheme maps to a line of body instead" independently
confirms dropping the mimi:// idea of bead mimid-1wgh.114.1: the draft
had already decided non-https schemes degrade to text.

{"notes":"DONE 2026-11-23, both writes pushed with Mark's OK: jmap-chat-spec 0f187aa (items 1, 2 and 3, the MIMI binding) and fb05ead (item 4, the VTC bridge). Item 5 was to change nothing in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00, and nothing was changed. Found while writing item 4 and filed separately: room-policy spells parent_dependant two ways (bead mimid-1wgh.37.112). STILL OPEN here: the mimid-server change that goes with item 3 -- room_create.rs binds a Chat and reads it back to answer chatId, so suppressing it for a parent-dependent room is a response-shape change; and the agent's own JMAP front end needs the same rule.
ITEM 3 CORRECTED, not implemented as first written: the server does NOT suppress the Chat (bead mimid-1wgh.121 and jmap-chat-spec a756342). room_create.rs needs NO change, and chatId stays non-null. What is needed instead: mimid-server sets the Chat's parentRoomId for a room it hubs, and the agent's front end (render.rs new_chat) does not project a call room as a Chat.
IMPLEMENTED 2026-11-23, with one item deliberately not done.

DONE:
- The agent's front end does not project a call room as a Chat, nor any
  Message of one: mimid-agent-jmap render.rs Render::is_call_room,
  applied in persist.rs seeds() for both rooms and messages and in
  project.rs project_room and project_message. Test: mimid-agent-jmap
  tests/two_accounts.rs a_call_room_is_not_a_chat, which checks both
  sides keep exactly one Chat while the store keeps the call's room,
  that bob's record knows which chat the call is under, and that
  signalling in it becomes no Message.

NOT DONE, and conformantly so: mimid-server does NOT set the Chat's
parentRoomId. The field needs the room's base policy at projection time,
which means a follower_room column and a schema migration, and
draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi §Chat.roomId already says only a server that
holds the room's policy can set it and "Such a server omits the field".
mimid's own clients talk to the AGENT, which is an MLS member and reads
the policy itself (Agent::parent_room, Room::parent), so the
provider-side field would tell our agent something it already knows. Its
value is for a different architecture: a thin client against a
provider's JMAP endpoint directly.

THE LIMITATION THAT FOLLOWS, and it should be in the server's docs: a
thin client talking to mimid-server's JMAP endpoint cannot tell a call
room's Chat from a chat's. Nothing in mimid is such a client. Filed here
rather than pretended away."}

Done, all four items: jmap-chat-spec 0f187aa and fb05ead, with item 3 corrected by bead mimid-1wgh.121 (the Chat stays, parentRoomId tells a client what it is). Item 5 was to change nothing in the base chat draft, and nothing changed.
